properties.description: Gather what the existing detectors and reports already found — dependency cycles, articulation points, misplaced capabilities, decomposition mismatches, modularity, surprising couplings, build granularity, the trajectory bands — and attach each to the quality axis it bears on, naming the computation it came from. Report per axis whether a design graph can inform it at all, with the reason where it cannot. Never derive a score and never write to the graph. A finding counts against an axis only where its producing computation already treats it as a defect; ratios and positions are context. Where an asserted DimensionAssessment scores a target above the scale's own midpoint on an axis whose detectors found something against that same target, report the disagreement without ruling on it.
properties.name: Connect computed evidence to the quality axis it informs
